topics.title: Python Basics
topics.explanation: Python is a high-level, general-purpose programming language used to build applications, automate tasks, and analyze data.
topics.practice_question: What is Python?
topics.answer: Python is a high-level, general-purpose programming language.

topics.title: Variables
topics.explanation: A variable is a name used to store a value. Example: age = 20.
topics.practice_question: Write a Python statement that stores 25 in a variable named age.

topics.title: Data Types
topics.explanation: Common Python data types include int for integers, float for decimal numbers, str for text, and bool for True or False values.
topics.practice_question: What is the data type of the value 'Hello'?

topics.title: Operators
topics.explanation: Python operators are used to perform calculations, comparisons, assignments, and logical operations.
topics.practice_question: What is the result of 10 + 5 in Python?

topics.title: Conditional Statements
topics.explanation: Conditional statements allow a Python program to make decisions based on whether a condition is True or False.
topics.practice_question: Write an if statement that prints 'Adult' when age is greater than or equal to 18.

topics.title: Loops
topics.explanation: Loops are used to repeatedly execute a block of Python code. Common loops are for and while.
topics.practice_question: Which Python loop is commonly used to iterate through a list?

topics.title: Strings
topics.explanation: A string is a sequence of characters used to represent text in Python. Strings support indexing, slicing, and useful methods such as upper(), lower(), replace(), and split().
topics.practice_question: Which Python method converts a string to uppercase?

topics.title: Functions
topics.explanation: A function is a reusable block of code that performs a specific task. Functions are defined using the def keyword.
topics.practice_question: Write a function named add that accepts two numbers and returns their sum.
topics.answer: def add(a, b): return a + b

topics.title: Lists
topics.explanation: A list is an ordered and changeable collection that can store multiple values in Python.
topics.practice_question: How do you add an item to the end of a Python list?

topics.title: Dictionaries
topics.explanation: A dictionary stores data as key-value pairs. Each key is used to access its corresponding value.
topics.practice_question: How do you create a Python dictionary containing a name and age?

topics.title: Tuples and Sets
topics.explanation: Tuples are ordered and immutable collections, while sets are unordered collections that store unique values.
topics.practice_question: Which Python collection automatically removes duplicate values?

topics.title: List Comprehensions
topics.explanation: List comprehensions provide a concise way to create lists from an iterable, optionally applying a condition.
topics.practice_question: What Python feature provides a concise way to create a list using an expression and a loop?

topics.title: Lambda Functions
topics.explanation: A lambda function is a small anonymous function written using the lambda keyword. It can accept arguments and return an expression.
topics.practice_question: Which keyword is used to create an anonymous function in Python?

topics.title: Map, Filter and Reduce
topics.explanation: map() transforms items, filter() selects items based on a condition, and reduce() combines values into a single result.
topics.practice_question: Which function is used to select elements from an iterable based on a condition?

topics.title: Recursion
topics.explanation: Recursion occurs when a function calls itself to solve a problem. A recursive function normally requires a base case to stop the recursion.
topics.practice_question: What is required to stop a recursive function from continuing indefinitely?

topics.title: Args and Kwargs
topics.explanation: *args allows a function to accept a variable number of positional arguments, while **kwargs allows a variable number of keyword arguments.
topics.practice_question: Which syntax allows a Python function to accept a variable number of keyword arguments?

topics.title: File Handling
topics.explanation: Python provides file handling features for reading and writing data stored in files using functions such as open().
topics.practice_question: Which Python function is used to open a file?

topics.title: JSON Handling
topics.explanation: Python's json module allows programs to encode and decode JSON data using functions such as dumps(), loads(), dump(), and load().
topics.practice_question: Which Python module is commonly used to work with JSON data?

topics.title: Date and Time
topics.explanation: Python provides the datetime module for working with dates and times.
topics.practice_question: Which Python module is commonly used for working with dates and times?

topics.title: Regular Expressions
topics.explanation: Regular expressions are patterns used to search, match, and manipulate text. Python provides regular expression support through the re module.
topics.practice_question: Which Python module provides support for regular expressions?

topics.title: Exception Handling
topics.explanation: Exception handling allows Python programs to handle runtime errors using try, except, else, and finally blocks.
topics.practice_question: Which keyword is used to catch an exception in Python?

topics.title: Object-Oriented Programming
topics.explanation: Object-oriented programming organizes programs using classes and objects. Classes can contain attributes and methods.
topics.practice_question: Which keyword is used to define a class in Python?

topics.title: Inheritance
topics.explanation: Inheritance allows a class to reuse and extend attributes and methods from another class.
topics.practice_question: What is inheritance in Python?
topics.answer: Inheritance allows one class to reuse and extend another class.

topics.title: Decorators
topics.explanation: Decorators are functions that modify or extend the behavior of another function without changing its original code.
topics.practice_question: Which symbol is commonly used to apply a decorator in Python?

topics.title: Generators
topics.explanation: Generators produce values one at a time using the yield keyword, which can help reduce memory usage.
topics.practice_question: Which keyword is used to produce values from a Python generator?

topics.title: Modules and Packages
topics.explanation: Modules allow Python code to be organized into reusable files, while packages organize related modules into directories.
topics.practice_question: Which keyword is commonly used to include a module in a Python program?

topics.title: Virtual Environments
topics.explanation: A virtual environment creates an isolated Python environment so that project dependencies can be installed separately.
topics.practice_question: Which Python module is commonly used to create a virtual environment?

topics.title: Pip and Package Management
topics.explanation: pip is a package management tool commonly used to install and manage Python packages.
topics.practice_question: Which command is commonly used to install a Python package with pip?

topics.title: Python Testing
topics.explanation: Testing helps verify that Python programs behave as expected. Unit tests check individual parts of a program.
topics.practice_question: Why is testing important in software development?
topics.answer: Testing helps find errors and verify that software behaves as expected.
